notes: One entry per P2ID address scheme, keyed by its salt name (pvium.vault.v1; a later stack gets its own, e.g. pvium.vault.v2). A scheme fixes every address: p2id = CREATE2(factory, identityHash, vaultInitCodeHash), with identityHash computed under identityDomain. Each Pvium environment is a separate stack with its own factory: `production` (mainnets) and `sandbox` (testnets); within an environment the factory has one address on every chain. The scheme domain is also the factory's namespace (nsHash = keccak256(domain)) and the deterministic-deployment salt. Entries are history: once a production factory is recorded the entry is frozen, and a vault change means adding a new entry and moving `current`; older schemes stay derivable forever. A sandbox factory never freezes anything: while production is null, `node scripts/embed-p2id.mjs --update` refreshes vaultInitCodeHash from the Hardhat artifact and the sandbox factory is re-predicted. `verifiers` lists, per environment, the approved verifier of each circuit version (keyed by circuitVersion); the newest is what new payments fund under (fundWith). Verifiers are added when the policy approves them and are never removed, so older deposits stay claimable with their own verifier.
